influences.name: Nicolas Jaar
influences.context: one of the tracks I fell in love with immediately was Nicolas Jaar's Time for Us. It was like a magic moment, I felt what music can do to you in a club, and I wanted to create something similar, like music that takes you somewhere.

influences.name: Clemens Wolf
influences.context: with Trialog we really created an artistic world together with the contemporary artist Clemens Wolf and the VJs from lichterloh; their art influenced our music and vice versa.

influences.name: The Notwist
influences.context: We've both always listened to a lot of indie music; we both like bands such as Radiohead or The Notwist.
